afterSeparateC1.authority: Authenticated GET /v1/authority HTTP 200, LEGACY_WRITER epoch/version 1/1, approved public metadata only
afterSeparateC1.normalRoutes: All 16 business routes HTTP 403 under production Admin and ordinary sessions; nine mutations + four original reads + LIST_MY_TEAMS + directory search/resolve. No successful business writes.
afterSeparateC1.cursor: Lazy cursor retrieval cannot be reached through normal LEGACY_WRITER routes. Separately review a tightly scoped isolated proof using actual Read role and exact generated secret, no secret output, no permanent permission change. Prior Ntgre success is design evidence, not production decryption proof.
afterSeparateC1.monitoring: Correlate request IDs, structured root EMF, native API/Lambda errors/throttles, DynamoDB and Core dependency counters, actual alarm datapoints. Account for bounded ingestion; never infer counters from HTTP status alone.
